_comment: A RATCHET, not a target. These numbers sit just above what the live site
actually measured on 8 Nov 2026, so any regression fails immediately,
and they get tightened as weight comes off. A budget set at the ideal
fails on every run on day one and gets ignored, which is worse than none.
Measured 8 Nov 2026 (Lighthouse CI, five core pages):
script transfer   488 KB homepage, 449-465 KB elsewhere   target 350 KB
total blocking    1245 ms homepage                        target 300 ms
The script figure is transfer size for the whole page, not the 103 kB of
first-load JS shared by all routes. The gap is route-level code: three,
monaco, xterm, d3, jspdf and html2canvas. Each must stay dynamically
imported behind its own route (CLAUDE.md §11) — this file is what notices
when one escapes into a shared layout.
